description:
At Amazon, security is a top priority. Are you interested in shaping the future of Amazon Security? Do you want to be part of building something with massive impact? Amazon Field Security (AFS) is looking for strong software engineers to join us as we make security smarter and simpler for all AWS colleagues, partners, and contingent workers that interact with customers, so that every interaction meets the AWS Security Bar. Today is just the beginning, and we want you to be part of our journey to innovate the way in which our users experience security. 

We are seeking a software development engineer to design and build proactive security solutions at scale, working across AWS services and internal teams to reduce risk while accelerating secure delivery to customers who have the highest security bar. You will own the technical direction, delivery, and operational health of AI-powered security platforms that modernize, scale, and embed field security processes and their components throughout the life cycle of customer-facing deliverables from inception through release. You will have the opportunity to grow and make impact by defining the system architecture, owning and implementing specific components, and shaping the overall experience. Together we build highly available, secure, scalable, distributed, and event-driven systems. 

As a software development engineer, you contribute to all parts of the software and deployment lifecycle, including planning and requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. You really enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and working closely with your peers in a group of very smart and talented engineers focused on building transformative security services. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop new services that enhance security for AWS's global customer base. 

Key job responsibilities
- Build AI-powered security platforms and tooling — Design and implement LLM-based systems (leveraging Bedrock, SageMaker, and RAG patterns) for automated threat modeling, intelligent code scanning, security assessments, and compliance inspections. 
- Drive proactive security automation — Build systems that identify and remediate security issues in deliverables (code, threat models, content) without requiring explicit builder consent, moving from reactive reviews to proactive prevention. 
- Own operational excellence — Define and maintain SLAs, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and incident response for services you own; participate in on-call rotation to support 24/7 availability. 
- Lead technical design — Produce design documents, conduct trade-off analysis, and drive alignment across AFS security platforms, and partner teams on system architecture decisions. 
- Expand AFS service team capability — Transform AFS from a consulting-oriented team into a service team with self-service tooling, APIs, and automated workflows that scale security review capacity. 
- Raise the engineering bar — Contribute to the software engineering community by authoring or co-authoring team standards, mentoring less experienced engineers, and conducting code and design reviews. 
- Drive cross-team influence — Align with Application Security, AI focused security teams, and platform teams on shared infrastructure, security patterns, and tooling investments. 

A day in the life
You will collaborate with engineering teams across AWS to design, deliver, and refine solutions that make it easier for our global customers to operate secure and compliant workloads within AWS. You'll work closely with our business team to ensure a clear understanding of the core problem we aim to solve. You'll partner with developers, security engineers, data science specialists, product management and business stakeholders to create appropriate user stories and a roadmap, iterating based on feedback from field teams. You will write and review code, author design documents, and deploy through automated CI/CD pipelines. Once features are live, you will monitor infrastructure quality, latency, and cost. You will investigate and remediate operational and security issues. You will also take part in the team on-call rotation and share applied AI best practices across the team.

About the team
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience with version control systems and CI/CD pipeline implementation
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Strong programming skills in at least one systems-level or strongly typed language (Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript) and at least one scripting/ML language (Python)
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Sagemaker, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits .
